## Propiedades de la varianza

<div class="block-theorem fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="1">
  <div class="block-title" style="font-size: 30px;">Para constantes $a$, $b$ y v.a. $X$, $Y$ <strong>independientes</strong>:</div>
  <div class="block-body">

<ol>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify" data-fragment-index="2" style="font-size: 30px;">$\text{Var}(a) = 0$</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify" data-fragment-index="3" style="font-size: 30px;">$\text{Var}(aX) = a^2\, \text{Var}(X)$</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify" data-fragment-index="4" style="font-size: 30px;">$\text{Var}(X + b) = \text{Var}(X)$</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify" data-fragment-index="5" style="font-size: 30px;">$\text{Var}(aX + b) = a^2\, \text{Var}(X)$</li>
<li class="fragment fade-up text-justify" data-fragment-index="6" style="font-size: 30px;">$\text{Var}(X + Y) = \text{Var}(X) + \text{Var}(Y)$ </li>
</ol>
  </div>
</div>
